notifications.title: CLEAVE v3.3.0.0 is available
notifications.message: Big files, without the wait. Split and Merge now stream their output and read a workbook's layout without opening every cell, and "Keep all formatting" is several times faster on a fraction of the memory. Backlogs became a real monitor — every active and queued job shows its step and time left, above a strip with the batch's elapsed time, estimated finish, memory and free disk — and you can re-point a queued job's output before it starts. Includes everything from 3.2.5.0. Update for the latest.

notifications.title: What's new in CLEAVE v3.3.0.0
notifications.message: This release is about large workbooks. Split and Merge write output a row at a time instead of building the whole file in memory, read column widths and merged cells without touching every cell, and scale their workers to the RAM you have; "Keep all formatting" now captures only the cells that are actually coloured, turning minutes and gigabytes into seconds and megabytes. A new "Keep column widths" toggle (off by default) lets you skip the slowest remaining step. Backlogs shows each job's tool, current step and time left, plus the batch's elapsed time, estimated finish, memory use and free disk — and a queued job's output destination can be changed before it runs. Reconcile's side-by-side results sheet is now actually produced, the column-mapping search filters properly, file rows only reorder from their grip handle, help tips are short bullet lists, and output boxes remember several recent locations. Everything from 3.2.5.0 — Simulate in every tool, the live key preview, Batch Inspector's Deep scan, column names from a Name row — is included.
